summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py, which handles all eight depot formats and the shared export conventions (gzip, BOM and charset, mid-file directives and headers, per-row units, fixed-width layout switching, UTC conversion), and applies the correction and handover rules. I ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json, and tools/check_summary.py reports every value matches the reference figures.
